text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome (SJS). The clinical picture of blisters and mucosal ulcers shortly after starting captopril is classic for a severe cutaneous adverse reaction; the hiking history and lack of systemic symptoms like fever or respiratory distress make this less likely to be an infection or toxic epidermal necrolysis.
